scope: 50 frozen viewer images sampled from 1,000 C/E test images; not a full test evaluation
reference: Original SAM 3 pseudo-labels. Ignore 255; never infer missing background.
prediction: Native-size bilinear logits then raw argmax; no filtering.
aggregation: Pool non-ignored pixels across the 50 images before computing ratios. Metrics are fractions; undefined denominators are null. mIoU averages defined class IoUs.
axes: Rows: reference [background, sidewalk]; columns: prediction [background, sidewalk].
